title: Green Grass and Quiet Water
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When David was a shepherd boy
He watched his father's sheep;
He found them grass and quiet pools
And guarded them in sleep.

[Chorus]
The green grass and the quiet stream,
A Shepherd close and kind;
He walks in front through every dark
And leaves no lamb behind.

[Verse 2]
He makes me lie in pastures green,
He leads me by the stream,
He fills my cup up to the top
And guards me while I dream.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
And when the valley's dark and deep
I will not be afraid,
For He is walking right in front
Along the path He made.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So goodness follows where I go,
And mercy, every day;
And in His house I'll always live,
So rest, my lamb, and stay.

[Chorus]
mood: A shepherd's song at dusk. A slow, even walking pace under the voice, one soft footfall to a beat, like a flock being led home along a path it knows as the light goes. Felt piano in unhurried chords that settle a little lower with each verse, and one low note held under the chorus like the ground itself. Nothing rises. It ends slower than it began, settled and safe, the fold shut for the night.
